## Instructions for Accurately Documenting Reportable Workplace Accidents

**Crucially: Reportability is determined by regulations (OSHA in the US, for example). Know your reporting thresholds!**

**I. Immediate Actions (Right After the Incident)**

1. **Ensure Safety & First Aid:**  *Prioritize* the well-being of the injured employee(s) and anyone else involved.  Provide immediate first aid or medical attention.  Secure the scene to prevent further injury.
